mentions.snippet: English-language coverage: OrderEAT, a closed-loop school-cafeteria wallet app, raises US$2M led by Chile Ventures with participation from Driven VC, Seedstars, Add Ventures and angel investors including Sergio Fogel (dLocal founder). Founded 2019 in Punta del Este, Uruguay; now in 600+ schools across Mexico, Argentina, Uruguay, Chile and Peru, serving 250,000+ active students.
